annotations.title: Programmable tokens held by a wallet

description: The programmable tokens (CIP-113) a wallet holds. They are NOT at the wallet's own addresses: they sit under the standard's shared contract, owned by a credential, so `get_wallet` does not show them. Give an addr1… payment address, a stake1… stake address or a 56-hex owner credential; for a wallet address we look up its payment key and its stake key (the owner can be either). Each holding comes with the token's restrictions in plain words, whether the owner is on the token's block list, and a value when the token has a pool price (most do not).

address.description: addr1… payment address (including a smart-wallet address), stake1… stake address, or a 56-hex owner credential.
